host_link.physical: one SPI bus, mode 0, MSB first, active-low chip selects, FPGA oversampled at 50 MHz core; SCLK <= core/8 = 6.25 MHz; budget cases 5.00 and 6.25 MHz

CS_FB.response_magic: CNF3 (or a page: CAP3, FLT3, IDP3, card MAINT response)

rules: exact length per chip select (1408 or 768 rising SCLK edges); shorter, longer, early release or both chip selects asserted together: rejected, LINK fault
snapshot at synchronized CS assertion; commit only after CS release with exact length, CRC and semantic validation
CS guards >= 8 core ticks before the first rising edge and after the last falling edge, >= 8 ticks high between transactions
big-endian fields; u24 counters are low 24 bits of 32-bit FPGA counters, unwrapped by the host modulo 2^24
one sequence counter shared by both chip selects: next = last + 1, nonzero, no wrap; FB_READ, READ_PAGE, MAINT and NOP use sequence 0 and do not advance it
ABI byte 0x03 in every frame; no fallback to ABI 1 or 2 (CNC1_BAD_CAPS)
per_cycle_order: cnc1.read: CS_FB FB_READ (event ack) -> CNF3 feedback
LinuxCNC motion, kinematics and HAL functions
cnc1.write: CS_CMD UPDATE (rates + outputs) -> CNS3 (event, telemetry, timing)

host_frames.name: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE
host_frames.coverage: bytes 0..n-3, stored MSB first in the last two bytes
host_frames.hamming_distance: 4 at 1408-bit and 768-bit codewords: exhaustive search found no undetected pattern of weight 2 or 3 and found weight-4 patterns [AR]; the generator has the factor (x+1) and period 32767, so HD 4 holds to 32751 data bits
host_frames.why_kept: existing RTL streams it; the host link is a short internal bus whose other defences are exact length, magic, sequence, session and semantic checks; any rejection latches a fault rather than being retried

io_link.name: CRC-32C (Castagnoli, iSCSI)
io_link.coverage: bytes 0-35 of each 40-byte IOL1 frame, stored MSB first in bytes 36-39
io_link.hamming_distance: 6 at the 320-bit codeword (288 data bits): exhaustive search found no undetected pattern of weight <= 5 and found weight-6 patterns [AR]; comparison at the same length: CRC-32/IEEE HD 5, CRC-16/CCITT HD 4
io_link.why: output-card frames change physical outputs and cross board-to-board connectors; HD 6 detects every error of up to 5 bits and every burst up to 32 bits; the card MCU computes it in hardware (STM32G0 CRC unit, programmable polynomial [DS])

opcodes.name: NOP
opcodes.session_seq: session 0 or the current session; sequence 0
opcodes.effect: returns CNS3; changes nothing; never feeds a watchdog

opcodes.name: SYNC
opcodes.accepted_when: disarmed; I/O disabled; qualification complete; no power-cycle fault; inhibit released; payload zero
opcodes.effect: new session; clears clearable faults and per-channel latches; restarts faulted IOL1 ports with new epochs; does not set pos_continuity

opcodes.name: ARM
opcodes.accepted_when: record 5.3 rules (config_valid, mask == required_mask, installed, no asserted tripping alarm, rates zero) plus: both watchdog self-tests passed since power-up or motion-card change; every encoder in required_encoder_mask valid; motion-critical ports active; and the safety-interface preconditions of section 3.4a (accepted RESET_ARM release within reset_arm_window_ms when required, contactor de-energized, STO state as expected, reset/arm not held); otherwise refused with ARM_REFUSED
opcodes.effect: arms at zero rate; raises FPGA_MOTION_REQUEST and PERMIT_OUT_REQ; strobes OPI rearm (TX, A, B, BOE); starts 5 ms watchdog; consumes the reset/arm release; one progress_m pulse

opcodes.name: UPDATE
opcodes.accepted_when: armed, fault-free, mask == armed mask, unmasked rates zero, |rate| within clamp, I/O payload valid (zero while I/O disabled)
opcodes.effect: atomically replaces 12 rates and the whole output image; restarts the 5 ms motion watchdog and, when I/O is enabled, the 5 ms I/O watchdog; one progress_m pulse; one progress_o pulse when I/O enabled

opcodes.name: DISARM
opcodes.accepted_when: mask and rates zero; accepted with faults latched
opcodes.effect: clean commanded stop (section 04 4.2): no new STEP pulses, current pulse completes, then request drops; pos_continuity kept only if the stop was clean

opcodes.name: READ_PAGE
opcodes.accepted_when: motion disarmed; byte 16 = page 0-3; bytes 17-173 zero
opcodes.effect: the next completed CS_FB transaction returns the page instead of CNF3 and consumes it (v2 rule)

opcodes.name: CONFIGURE
opcodes.session_seq: record 5.3 rule (session 0/sequence 0 before a session, else current session and next sequence)
opcodes.accepted_when: disarmed; I/O disabled; qualification complete; payload valid
opcodes.effect: record 5.3 accept/reject semantics; rejection clears config_valid, required_mask and alarm masks

opcodes.name: CONFIGURE_IO
opcodes.effect: page 0 or 1 replaces that page atomically and clears io_config_valid until page 0 is re-accepted with a matching io_config_hash; pages 2-9 queue a CONFIG_WRITE to the named port; any rejection clears io_config_valid

opcodes.name: IO_CLEAR_FAULTS
opcodes.accepted_when: motion disarmed; I/O enabled; each cleared output commanded 0 in this frame's dout_image; rates and mask zero (while armed the same clear travels in UPDATE bytes 80-81)
opcodes.effect: clears the named output fault latches (FPGA and card); does not re-energize anything; one progress_o pulse

opcodes.name: IO_WRITE
opcodes.accepted_when: motion disarmed; I/O enabled; rates and mask zero
opcodes.effect: replaces the output image; restarts the I/O watchdog; one progress_o pulse

opcodes.name: IO_ENABLE
opcodes.accepted_when: io_config_valid; required ports active and identity-matched; no I/O fault; output self-test passed; payload zero
opcodes.effect: raises FPGA_OUTPUT_REQUEST (SET1 of WD_O, OUT arm latch); strobes OPI_REARM_O; each card re-arms its own output-enable latch only after this and a new epoch (section 4.7); IOL1 frames carry OUT_REQ while OUT_PERMIT is high; one progress_o pulse

opcodes.name: IO_DISABLE
opcodes.accepted_when: payload zero; accepted with faults latched
opcodes.effect: zeroes the output image, drops OUT_REQ and FPGA_OUTPUT_REQUEST

opcodes.name: MAINT
opcodes.accepted_when: motion disarmed; I/O disabled; byte 16 = port 0-3, bytes 17-56 = one complete 40-byte IOL1 frame with control b5 set; rest zero
opcodes.effect: forwards the frame to the port; the card response returns as the next CS_FB response (page mechanism); used for card firmware update and identity reads

opcodes.name: SELFTEST
opcodes.accepted_when: disarmed; I/O disabled; no self-test running (the two tests never overlap); byte 16 = 1 motion watchdog, 2 output watchdog; rest zero
opcodes.effect: section 04 5.4: the FPGA enters SELFTEST and raises the request with EN_N_i forced high, rates zero, PEN/PWM/AO requests zero, PERMIT_OUT_REQ low (PERMIT_OUT stays open) and OUT_REQ zero in every IOL1 frame (card enables stay low); result in safety word b21/b22 and fault bit WATCHDOG_SELFTEST_FAILED

opcodes.name: CLEAR_CONTINUITY
opcodes.accepted_when: disarmed; channel_mask names channels whose re-reference the host has completed; rest zero

opcodes.name: FB_READ
opcodes.effect: returns CNF3; pops the event ring when event_ack equals the event last shown; never feeds a watchdog

fault_word.name: IO_WATCHDOG
fault_word.cause: 5 ms without accepted UPDATE/IO_WRITE while I/O enabled

fault_word.name: OUTPUT_READBACK_MISMATCH
fault_word.cause: the state a card reports in response n (applied after command n-1) differs from the image the FPGA sent in command n-1, in two consecutive responses (section 4.8)
fault_word.response: output forced off; I/O disabled if motion-critical

fault_word.name: DO_FAULT

fault_word.name: IO_CONFIG_REJECTED
fault_word.cause: CONFIGURE_IO rejected or card rejected CONFIG_WRITE

fault_word.name: EVENT_OVERFLOW
fault_word.cause: event ring full when a new event arrived
fault_word.response: none on outputs; probe/index results after the overflow unusable

fault_word.name: ENCODER_FAULT
fault_word.cause: illegal transition or port supply fault on an encoder in required_encoder_mask while armed; a single open or shorted line is not detected in IS-1 (section 8.1)

fault_word.name: POWER_FAULT
fault_word.cause: F_PGOOD_A/B, MOTION_5V, EXP_PGOOD or CORE power-good low

fault_word.cause: EXT_PERMIT low while armed or I/O enabled

fault_word.cause: OPI_OK_OUT cleared (the OUT_PERMIT final gate fell, however short) or OUT_PERMIT readback low while I/O enabled
fault_word.response: I/O disabled; FPGA_OUTPUT_REQUEST dropped; every output card has already latched its own enable off in hardware (section 4.7) and stays off until a new epoch and IO_ENABLE

fault_word.name: PROCESS_PERMIT_LOST
fault_word.cause: PROC_PERMIT fell while a PEN was requested

fault_word.name: SLOT_FAULT
fault_word.cause: presence A/B or power-good of DIC, DOA, DOB, ACC, ESC, CMC or XS fell in the MC slot status register (section 4.10; two agreeing reads)

fault_word.name: CONTACTOR_FEEDBACK

fault_word.response: disarm all (PERMIT_OUT opens with TX_PERMIT); ARM refused while set
fault_word.cleared_by: SYNC after the input agrees with the disarmed state

fault_word.name: STO_FEEDBACK
fault_word.cause: sto_fb (XS1.8) disagrees with the expected STO state for longer than sto_response_ms: mode 1, STO active exactly while PERMIT_OUT is open; mode 2, STO active while armed (section 3.4a)
fault_word.response: disarm all; ARM refused while set
fault_word.cleared_by: SYNC after the input agrees with the disarmed state

fault_word.name: ARM_REFUSED
fault_word.cause: ARM received while a safety-interface precondition was unmet: no accepted RESET_ARM release within reset_arm_window_ms (when required), reset/arm held longer than reset_arm_press_max_ms, contactor not de-energized, STO state unexpected, or EXT_PERMIT low (section 3.4a)
fault_word.response: nothing armed; a SAFETY_INTERFACE event names the unmet precondition

events.name: PROBE_CAPTURE

events.flags: b0 overcurrent/current limit; b1 thermal; b2 open load on; b3 open load off; b4 short to VS

events.name: WATCHDOG_TRIP

events.flags: b0 presence A; b1 presence B; b2 PGOOD; b3 tamper

events.flags: source 5: b0 no reset/arm release, b1 contactor, b2 STO, b3 EXT_PERMIT low, b4 reset/arm stuck; other sources: b0 new level
events.values: v0 duration in ms (press time, mismatch time); v1-v3 zero

telemetry.delivery: one entry per CNS3 response (1 per servo cycle); fixed round robin over all entries; a host priority request (FB_READ bytes 17-18) may take at most every other slot, so every entry is delivered at least every 45 cycles without priority requests and every 90 cycles with them

DIC: p0: 0-1 SENS_G0 mV; 2-3 SENS_G1 mV; 4-5 SENS_G2 mV; 6 limiter fault bits; 7 safety-supply fault bits; 8-9 SAFE_24V mV
p1: 0-1 MCU temperature 0.1 C (s16); 2-3 MCU VDD mV; 4 reset cause; 5 firmware minor; 6-9 applied config CRC-32C
p2: card-side link counters u16: 0-1 CRC, 2-3 format, 4-5 sequence/epoch, 6-7 identity, 8-9 accept-timer trips
DO8: p0-p7 (output k): 0-1 ISNS code (10-bit; 0xFFFF = not measured: output off, ADC reported FF, or diagnostics disabled); 2-3 TSNS code; 4-5 VOUT code; 6-7 age of the ADC values at transmission, us; 8 b0 output on during sample, b1 ISNS saturated, b2 below qualified accuracy range (card factory record); 9 output index
p8: 0-1 VS code device 0; 2-3 VS code device 1; 4-5 MCU temperature 0.1 C; 6-7 MCU VDD mV; 8 reset cause; 9 firmware minor
p9: card-side link counters (as DIC p2)

p10: 0-4 fault detail, 5 bits per output (overcurrent, thermal, open load on, open load off, short to VS), packed MSB first; 5 device 0 global flags; 6 device 1 global flags; 7 FLT pin levels; 8-9 driver SPI error count
p11: 0-3 applied config CRC-32C; 4-7 factory record CRC-32C; 8-9 zero
ACC: p0-p3 (AI k): 0-1 raw code; 2-3 sample age us; 4 range code; 5 flags (over, under, open); 6-9 zero
p4: 0-1 AO0 readback; 2-3 AO1 readback; 4 DAC alarm flags; 5 clamp state; 6-9 zero
p5: 0-1 AI reference mV; 2-3 AI sensor supply mV; 4 sensor supply fault; 5 PWM auxiliary fault; 6 isolated-supply power-good bits (AO0, AO1, AI, RS-485, CAN); 7 zero; 8-9 MCU temperature 0.1 C
p7: 0-3 applied config CRC-32C; 4-7 factory record CRC-32C; 8-9 firmware version
EIA_status_register: p0: 0-2 raw 24-bit image; 3 marker-check failures (mod 256); 4-9 zero
EX8_status_register: p0: 0-1 raw 16-bit image; 2 marker-check failures; 3-9 zero
FPGA_core_0x80: p0: 0-1 max UPDATE interval since last delivery us; 2-3 late count; 4-5 min UPDATE interval us; 6-7 rejected host frames since power-up; 8-9 event ring high-water mark
p1: 0-3 seconds since configuration; 4-7 latched-fault count since power-up; 8-9 zero
FPGA_port_counters_0x81_0x86: p0: u16 counters 0-1 CRC, 2-3 format/SOF/length/timeout, 4-5 sequence/epoch, 6-7 identity, 8-9 readback mismatch

telemetry.display_rule: every value is published with valid and age; unavailable, not measured or stale is never published as zero (T4)
telemetry.stale_rule: one rule: the fixed per-source stale limit of telemetry_map[].stale_ms and host_sources[].stale_ms; a value older than its limit is shown 'stale', a source with no path is 'unavailable', neither is ever shown as 0 (T4)

io_link.name: IOL1
io_link.topology: point-to-point, one FPGA SPI master per card slot, 4 wires (SCLK, CMD, RSP, CS_N), 3.3 V LVCMOS through Ioff buffers at each card connector

card_classes.name: DIC
card_classes.command_payload: all zero in ACTIVE; CONFIG_WRITE: blob index + 24 B
card_classes.realtime: 0-2 DI filtered (24 bits); 3-5 DI raw; 6-7 sample age us; 8 sensor-group limiter fault bits; 9 safety-supply fault bits; 10-15 zero
card_classes.config_blob: 0 format 1; 1-3 debounce per 8-input group, 100 us units (0-255); 4-23 zero

card_classes.name: DO8 (DOA slot 1, DOB slot 2)
card_classes.command_payload: 0 output image (8 bits); 1 fault-clear mask; 2-25 zero
card_classes.realtime: 0 applied (SW_STATE readback AND driver enable); 1 fault any; 2 overcurrent/current limit; 3 thermal; 4 open load on; 5 open load off; 6 short to VS; 7 b0-1 FLT pins, b2-3 VS undervoltage dev0/1, b4-5 SPI/CRC error dev0/1, b6 OUT_PERMIT drop latched (OUT_EN latch cleared); 8-9 readback age us; 10-15 zero
card_classes.config_blob: 0 format 1; 1-8 ILIM_REG[3:0] code per output: default 0110 = 0.72 A setting (0.62-0.82 A [DS Table 8-4 and ICL table]); codes above 0111 (0.85 A setting, 0.72-1.00 A [DS]) are rejected so the limit never exceeds section 04's 1.0 A maximum; 9 on-state open-load enable mask; 10 off-state open-load enable mask; 11 inrush code: INRUSH_LIMIT 00 (same limit) or 10 (0.5x) only; 01 (2x) and 11 (fixed 2.2 A) are rejected; 12 latch-off (retry disable) mask; 13-23 zero

card_classes.name: ACC
card_classes.command_payload: 0-1 AO0 code; 2-3 AO1 code; 4 b0-1 AO enable; 5-25 zero
card_classes.realtime: 0-1 AO0 applied (DAC register readback); 2-3 AO1 applied; 4-5 AI0; 6-7 AI1; 8-9 AI2; 10-11 AI3; 12-13 AI sample age us; 14 AI valid/range bits; 15 AO status (b0-1 clamp, b2-3 readback ok, b4 DAC reference alarm, b5 OUT_PERMIT drop latched, b6 PROC_PERMIT drop latched)
card_classes.config_blob: 0 format 1; 1-4 AI range code per channel; 5 AI sample-rate code (>= 1 kHz per channel); 6 RS-485 termination; 7 CAN termination; 8-23 zero

card_classes.name: BOOT (any card in its bootloader)
card_classes.realtime: bootloader status; IWDG refreshed by the SRAM erase/program routine; outputs off

validate_before_commit: complete 40-byte frame, CS released after exactly 320 clocks, no SPI overrun
epoch == current epoch (SYNC: new nonzero epoch with sequence 0)
class semantic checks (output bits within the configured mask, AO code <= configured maximum)
only then: apply outputs, reload the accept timer, refresh the IWDG, store epoch/sequence

card_watchdogs.accept_timer: firmware timer reloaded only on a fully accepted frame; 1.0 ms (10 link periods); expiry: outputs off, FAULT_LATCHED until a new SYNC epoch
card_watchdogs.iwdg: STM32G0 independent watchdog, hardware-started by option byte; in the application it is refreshed only in the accept path; maximum timeout <= 2 ms over the LSI tolerance [REQ]; reset leaves CARD_EN low. In the bootloader (outputs off, CARD_EN low) flash erase and program run from an SRAM routine with interrupts off that refreshes the IWDG while polling the flash busy flag, so a page erase longer than the IWDG timeout never resets the card
card_watchdogs.hardware_gates: output enable = qualified OUT_PERMIT_k (hardwired, section 04) AND OUT_EN latch Q AND CARD_EN (MCU pin with pull-down). The OUT_EN latch (one half of an SN74LVC2G74DCUR on each DO and ACC card) has D = 1, CLK = MCU OUT_EN_ARM strobe, asynchronous CLR_N = the qualified OUT_PERMIT_k net, so any accepted OUT_PERMIT_k drop, however short, turns the outputs off and keeps them off; the MCU reads Q, reports the drop (realtime b6 of the status byte), writes SW_STATE = 0 and re-arms the latch only in ACTIVE after a new epoch and IO_ENABLE. The ACC uses the second half the same way for PROC_PERMIT (PEN latch)

io_link.output_readback: response n carries the state applied after command n-1; the FPGA compares it with the image it sent in command n-1; two consecutive mismatches latch OUTPUT_READBACK_MISMATCH for that output
io_link.fpga_port_rules: a response is used only after its CRC, SOF, class, slot, epoch echo and sequence echo check; 3 consecutive failures latch the port fault; DI/AI keep the last valid value with growing age and turn invalid at the earlier of their stale limit and the port fault
io_link.restart: power-up or card reset: INIT, outputs off; FPGA sends SYNC frames with a new epoch; identity (IDENT_READ) and configuration (CONFIG_WRITE) are verified; ACTIVE only after the host's IO_ENABLE; a card reset in operation shows as an epoch mismatch and reset cause and latches the port fault; no automatic resume

EIA.layout: bits 0-9 MPG_SEL_X..PEND_AUX; 10 MPG_ENABLE; 11 XF present; 12 XF supply fault; 13 MPG supply fault; 14-15 probe 0/1 supply fault; 16-19 ENC0-3 supply fault; 20-23 fixed marker 1010 (tied on the far end of the chain)
EIA.acceptance: marker must read 1010 and two consecutive reads must agree before a bit changes in STS; three consecutive marker failures latch IO_LINK_FAULT on port S0

EX8.layout: bits 0-7 ENC4-11 supply fault; 8 EX8 power-good; 9-11 zero; 12-15 marker 1010

status_registers.note: Input-only status registers carry no outputs, so the validate-before-commit rule for output cards does not apply; the fixed marker plus double-read agreement detects stuck, open and shifted chains. The worst-case age of a status bit at the FB snapshot is 2 x 100 us + one read (4.16 us) [AR]. The MC slot status register collects the presence contacts and power-good of every slot that has no other path to the FPGA; its inputs arrive through the base on the MC connector (section 02 section 6).

MC_slot.layout: bits 0-28 as CNS3 slot_status b0-28 (presence A, presence B, power-good of EIA, EX8, DIC, DOA, DOB, ACC, ESC, CMC, XS; SCART presence A/B); 29-35 zero; 36-39 fixed marker 1010
MC_slot.acceptance: marker must read 1010 and two consecutive reads must agree before a bit changes in STS; a fall of a presence or power-good bit of a fitted card latches SLOT_FAULT; three consecutive marker failures latch IO_LINK_FAULT; worst-case age at the snapshot 2 x 100 us + 5.12 us read = 205.12 us [AR]

IOL1 x4 (DIC, DOA, DOB, ACC): SCLK, CMD, RSP, CS_N point-to-point with Ioff buffers and series termination at each card; 4 slot-strap bits per slot on the base

Card MCU: STM32G031C8T6 on DIC, STM32G031K8T6 on DOA, DOB and ACC; SPI1 slave with DMA; IWDG hardware option; CARD_EN pin with pull-down ANDed with OUT_PERMIT_k into every output enable; SWD factory pads only

CAN: MCP2518FDT-E/SL on a compute SPI bus separate from the motion SPI; RS-485: compute UART with RTS for kernel RS-485 direction control; both transceivers isolated on ACC (section 03)
PSM entry voltage/current monitors readable on a host I2C branch
Motion-card temperature: the AT30TSE752A-XM8M-T fitted to every electronic card (section 02 section 9) is the MC board sensor; place it near the FPGA and the watchdog/permission logic

DOA/DOB: 2 x TPS274C65ASRHAR in addressable SPI mode behind one ISO7762FDBQR (4 forward: SCLK, SDI, CS_N, DO_EN; 2 reverse: SDO and the wired-OR FLT of both devices); the F variant's default-low outputs leave DO_EN low when the logic side is unpowered

MC slot status register (input-only, 40 bits, marker 1010 at the far end, 74HC165-class) reading presence A/B and power-good of EIA, EX8, DIC, DOA, DOB, ACC, ESC, CMC and XS and SCART presence A/B; those 29 lines cross the base to the MC connector; SSR_CLK/SSR_LOAD_N/SSR_DATA are local FPGA pins
OPI_OK_OUT and OPI_OK_BOE latches (SN74LVC2G74DCUR) on the MC and the OPI_REARM_O strobe; PERMIT_OUT drive = TX_PERMIT AND PERMIT_OUT_REQ (FPGA pin, 10 kOhm pull-down) on the MC (section 04 6.2)

on every DO and ACC card an OUT_EN latch (one half of SN74LVC2G74DCUR; ACC: second half for PROC_PERMIT) with CLR_N = the qualified OUT_PERMIT_k net, in series with CARD_EN in every output enable, Q read by the card MCU
